name: Plaguebearer

bonuses.name: Fly Infestation
bonuses.text: Swarms of small flies surround Plaguebearers. Melee attacks through the swarm suffer +1 DN, as attackers must contend with the insects. Anyone with the NURGLE keyword is unaffected.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Reprint of plaguebearer; differs in attributes (Wil/Int/Fel), Defence, skills, Resilience note, Tier row (A A E T T, Core A A E E), bonus (Fly Infestation for Cloud of Flies), Plaguesword and Determination. Skill printed 'Weapons Skill 8'.
